verified_title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
problem: Autoregressive video/action policies need real feedback and temporal context, but asynchronously reusing stale imagined states can compound visual drift and ignore newly observed execution errors.
contribution: LingBot-VA couples5B video and350M action streams under chunk-causal teacher forcing, uses partial video denoising and variable chunk sizes, and refreshes asynchronous forecasts through a forward-dynamics pass conditioned on actual recent observations and currently executing controls.
algorithm: Wan2.2-5B causal VAE tokens and action embeddings interleave at4actions/video frame. Separate-width transformer streams share cross-modal attention. Initialize action weights by interpolating video weights with variance scaling. Train flow-matching dynamics+inverse losses with50% noisy visual-history augmentation. The async pipeline receives real observations, predicts consequences of the current action, then uses that refreshed forecast to generate the next action chunk.
observations: Language, camera history and action history; deployed async context is explicitly truncated to recent actual observation/executed/current chunks, despite broader claims of full persistent history. Command history encodes nominal configuration, which must not be mistaken for measured joint feedback.
actions: Universal30D dual-arm representation: perarm7D EE pose/quaternion+7padded joints+gripper. Target-data quantile normalization; differing robot dimensions are padded. Fourfold denser actions than video. This redundant representation still requires a consistent calibrated robot-specific consumer.
embodiment_and_data: ~16000h fromAgibot,RoboMind,InternData-A1,OXE,UMI,RoboCOIN andinternal data,90/10splits.5.3B total parameters and1.4T pretraining tokens. Real six tasks use50demos/task; RoboTwin2500clean+25000randomized demos. Exact physical arm model and hardware inference GPU NOT_EXTRACTED.
experiments: RoboTwin50tasks,LIBEROfour suites with1500evaluations/suite across3seeds. Physical long-horizon,precision andcloth/pants tasks report author binary success alongside per-stage progress, with per-trial appendices. Memory tests count six wipes and search two boxes; robustness of long-history claims must consider the actual truncated async context. Ablations compare naive async,FDM-groundedasync,baseline andWan initialization.
baselines: pi0.5 in physical experiments;pi0,X-VLA,Motus and other published VLA results in simulation. Some baseline results are adopted from prior papers rather than uniformly re-executed. Pretraining,architecture and observation-memory differences accompany performance differences.

quantitative_result.simulation: PDF p13 Table1:RoboTwin92.93%easy/91.55%hard versusMotus88.7/87.0. PDF p14 Table2:LIBERO98.5%average with1500trials/suite.
quantitative_result.asynchronous: PDF p15 Table3:baseline92.9%,FDM-groundedasync90.4%,naiveasync74.3%easy; horizon3 naive32.9 versusgrounded85.6. This supports grounding over naiveasync but does not show identical performance tobaseline. Text reports~2×task-speed benefit; hardware latency/denominator NOT_EXTRACTED.
quantitative_result.cloth: PDF p28 TableS4:n20/method, author-labeled shirt-fold successes7/20(35%)versuspi0.5 6/20(30%), but mean progress48.8%versus62.9%, contrary to the all-metrics superiority prose. Some author-labeled successes receive5/6stagepoints; these labels are not identical to attaining everyrubricpoint.

limitations: Temporal causal masking is not identified causal physics. Generated future trajectories and commanded state history may diverge from physical contact/slip. Async grounding helps but still loses2.5points versusbaseline. Shirt-fold data contradict blanket superiority across bothmetrics. Protocol details also vary: partial denoise stop0.5 inalgorithm versus0.6 implementation; variableK[1,8]illustration versus[1,4]implementation, and physical fine-tuning500steps versusgeneric1000/3000 guidance. Memory-box evaluation always tests a left-box target, limiting distributional evidence.
code_and_license: No pinned repository/implementation,model ordataset license verified; no execution. The review binds only the actual primary PDF and its evidence, not an assumed ready package.
hardware_adaptation: ADAPT the software lesson of grounding queued forecasts on actual timestamped feedback; evaluate stale-frame/jitter behavior offline before changing any execution path. Preserve existing controller settings.30D padded EE/joint outputs cannot be sent directly to SO101/M3.5.3B memory/runtime and the source's unspecified hardware do not establish NX feasibility; tactile/force feedback is future work rather than a capability already supplied.
